$comment: The test-world TYPE registry (not CORE-30's business registry): which business type each Dev Salon test store plays, and what the fill loader (fill.ts) creates for it. The stores map moves to stores.business_type when CORE-26 lands. Type ids = BusinessProfileKey values in src/business/lib/fixtures-settings.ts. One recipe = one store: a type must map exactly one store here; a second store of a type needs its own recipe and member-number series.
$realism: Per type, what realism.ts and the planner's days from a store's realismFrom (manifest) on follow: requestShare = share of bookings that carry a ご要望 line (recipes/<type>.ts requests); nominatedShare = share of customers who 指名 their 担当 (kept on every later visit); cancelShare / noShowShare = past loader bookings that end CANCELLED / NO_SHOW (reasons: cancelReasons below; 無断 = no-contact only); futureCancels = [min, max] future bookings per store already cancelled (事前連絡); rhythmDays = [min, max] days between a customer's visits (their own cadence clamped into it), rhythmJitter = ± days per visit.
$slotMinutes: Per store: the minutes between bookable starts, counted from the day's opening (any positive whole number up to the store's longest open day). A store not listed plays 30 until core ships CORE-10's per-store booking_step_min.
